fluff.overview: Federated Suns infantry benefit from one of the strongest industrial bases in the Inner Sphere, with AFFS quartermasters able to supply platoons with standardized equipment and ammunition from a logistics network that few rival states can match. Mechanized wheeled platoons ride wheeled transports that offer good speed on roads and developed terrain, making them well-suited to garrison duty on worlds with established infrastructure where rapid response matters more than cross-country capability. Carrying infantry-scale gauss rifles that use magnetic acceleration to propel projectiles at extreme velocities, these platoons field the longest-ranged and hardest-hitting personal ballistic weapon available to conventional soldiers.
